references.text: Here parallels are drawn to Mary's faith and trust in God's word, just as Sarah also believed in the Lord's promise of a son.
This verse reflects Mary's submission to God's will, similar to what is described in the Book of Psalms about doing God's will.
Mary's acceptance of her role as God's servant can be seen in light of Jeremiah's call, where he also accepted God's will for his life.
Elizabeth's blessing of Mary for her faith in the Lord's word mirrors Mary's own acceptance and belief in the angel's message.
Mary's faith and her response to the angel can be compared to the faith of the ancients, especially Sarah, who also believed God's promises.
